PrivacyTerms of Use

GaneshaTracker is a free, community-run map of Ganesh Chaturthi celebrations in Mysuru. By using the site or adding a listing, you agree to these simple terms.

What this site is

It is a non-commercial community project to help people discover neighbourhood Ganesha celebrations. It is offered as a helpful public resource, not a business, and not an official directory of any temple, association, or authority.

Adding a listing

When you add a Ganesha, you confirm that the details are accurate to the best of your knowledge, that the celebration is public, and that you have the right to share whatever you submit, including any photo. Please do not submit content that is false, misleading, offensive, unlawful, infringes someone's copyright, or shares another person's private information without consent. By submitting, you give permission for the content to be shown on the site.

Moderation

To keep the map useful and respectful, we may edit, re-categorise, verify, hide, or remove any listing at our discretion, with or without notice. The "Community verified" label is a light signal that a listing looks genuine. It is not an endorsement, a guarantee of accuracy, or any kind of official approval.

Accuracy, and travelling to a celebration

Locations, timings, immersion dates, and other details are submitted by the community and may be incomplete, outdated, or wrong. Please treat everything as a friendly pointer and confirm details yourself before travelling. The site is provided "as is," and to the extent allowed by law we are not liable for any loss, inconvenience, or damage arising from relying on information here or from visiting any celebration.

Photos and content you submit

You keep ownership of the photos and text you submit. You grant permission for them to be displayed on GaneshaTracker so the community can use the map. If you believe content infringes your rights or should not be there, tell us and we will remove it promptly.

Tips ("Buy me a filter coffee")

The coffee button lets you send a small, entirely voluntary tip to the site's maintainer through UPI. A tip is a gift of support, is non-refundable, and does not purchase any product, service, listing, or preferential treatment.

Links to other sites

Listings may link to Instagram pages, other social profiles, and Google Maps. Those services are run by others and have their own terms and privacy practices. We are not responsible for their content.

Removing your content or reporting a problem

To correct or remove a listing or photo, or to report anything inappropriate, email contact@sjruthvik.in.

Changes and governing law

These terms may be updated as the site evolves; the date above shows the latest version, and continued use means you accept it. These terms are governed by the laws of India, with the courts of Mysuru, Karnataka having jurisdiction.

These are plain-language terms for a small community project, provided in good faith. They are not legal advice.
